editorial:
Imagine a world where the people you should trust the most are actually the ones putting kids in danger. You get dropped right into a tense situation where a group of nasty criminals thinks they can use children to pull off their dirty work. It feels like a classic cat-and-mouse game where the stakes are way too high, and the vibe is heavy with suspense from the very first scene. You will find yourself rooting for the police officers who are racing against the clock to figure out who the bad guys are before something terrible happens to the kids.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you guessing. The acting is solid and the pacing stays quick so you never get bored. While some of the 80s effects look a bit dated now, the story is still strong enough to keep you on the edge of your seat. If you love old-school crime mysteries, you should definitely check this one out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night or add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection if you want the best picture quality possible.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the police track down the gang's secret hideout. In a final showdown, the officers manage to rescue the children just before the criminals can move them. The twist reveals exactly who the Fourth person was and how they planned to betray the others. The bad guys are all arrested in a big sweep, and the movie ends with the kids safe and the streets clean again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school police mysteries and rescue stories.
